title: 12" silent running battery clock
text: 12" silent running battery clock. I hate the sound of a battery clock - so I always purchase the "silent" ones.  This one is completely silent - sweep second hand - very subtle face.  I love it. Approx 12" round. Stylish but not garish. You will need AA batteries.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
